title: Billboard Graphic
text:
library(tidyverse)


data("billboard", package = "tidyr")

billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(chart_date = as.Date(date.entered) + weeks(week - 1))

july_top_five <- billboard_long |>
  filter(chart_date <= as.Date("2000-07-01")) |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  slice_max(chart_date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  slice_min(rank, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  transmute(artist, track, song_artist = paste0(track, " (", artist, ")"))

billboard_long |>
  inner_join(july_top_five, by = c("artist", "track")) |>
  filter(chart_date >= as.Date("2000-01-01"),
         chart_date <= as.Date("2001-01-01")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = chart_date, y = rank, color = song_artist, group = song_artist)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(100, 1)) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b",
    limits = as.Date(c("2000-01-01", "2001-01-01"))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#56D6C9", "#FF6B6B", "#45B7D1", "#B794F4", "#FFCA58")) +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard Top 100: Top 5 Songs in July 2000",
    subtitle = "Rank changes throughout 2000",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Chart position",
    color = "Song (Artist)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#111827", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#111827", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#374151"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(color = "white"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#56D6C9", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#D1D5DB", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
